lines.text: It was a wonderful night, such a night as is only possible when we are young, dear reader…
lines.intention: Invites the reader in; loneliness underneath

lines.text: I know the houses too. As I walk along they seem to run forward in the streets to look out at me…
So now you understand, reader, in what sense I am acquainted with all Petersburg.
I have mentioned already that I had felt worried for three whole days…
I took long walks… when I suddenly found myself at the city gates.
There is something inexpressibly touching in nature round Petersburg…
lines.intention: Beauty that fades too soon; foreshadowing

lines.text: And yet my night was better than my day! This was how it happened.
I came back to the town very late, and it had struck ten…
Leaning on the canal railing stood a woman… "She's a girl, and I am sure she is dark," I thought.
lines.intention: First sight of her; holding his breath

lines.text: "Strange," I thought… I heard a muffled sob. Yes! I was not mistaken, the girl was crying…
lines.intention: Heart sinks; too timid to act

lines.text: Along the same side of the pavement there suddenly came into sight… a gentleman in evening dress…
Suddenly, without a word to any one, the gentleman set off and flew full speed in pursuit…
"Give me your arm," I said to the girl. "And he won't dare to annoy us further."
lines.intention: Protective, surprised by his own courage

lines.text: She took my arm without a word, still trembling with excitement and terror…
On her black eyelashes there still glistened a tear… a gleam of a smile on her lips.
"There, you see; why did you drive me away? If I had been here, nothing would have happened...."
lines.intention: First words to her: lightly scolding, to hide his nerves

lines.text: "But I did not know you; I thought that you too...."
lines.intention: Her only truly shy moment; still shaken

lines.text: "Why, do you know me now?"
"A little! Here, for instance, why are you trembling?"
lines.intention: She regains herself and turns the tables

lines.text: "Oh, you are right at the first guess!" I answered, delighted… "I am shy with women, I am agitated…"
"What? Really?..."
"Yes; if my arm trembles, it is because it has never been held by a pretty little hand like yours…"
lines.intention: Bares his loneliness, hoping not to offend

lines.text: "No, nothing, nothing, quite the contrary… I like it too, and I won't drive you away till I get home."
lines.intention: Decides to be kind; a little bold

lines.text: "You will make me," I said, breathless with delight, "lose my timidity, and then farewell to all my chances...."
"Chances! What chances--of what? That's not so nice."
lines.intention: Pounces on the slip, half joking

lines.text: "I beg your pardon, I am sorry, it was a slip of the tongue…"
"To be liked, eh?"
"Well, yes; but do, for goodness' sake, be kind. Think what I am! Here, I am twenty-six…"
"How? With whom?..."
"Why, with no one, with an ideal, with the one I dream of in my sleep…"
lines.intention: Long monologue; carried away by his own fantasy

lines.text: "Don't be vexed; I am only laughing at your being your own enemy…"
lines.intention: Laughs, then wise beyond her years

lines.text: "Oh, thank you," I cried; "you don't know what you have done for me now!"
"I am glad! I am glad! But tell me how did you find out that I was the sort of woman…"
"What made me?... But you were alone; that gentleman was too insolent; it's night…"
"No, no; I mean before, on the other side--you know you meant to come up to me."
"On the other side? Really I don't know how to answer; I am afraid to.... I fancied you were crying…"
"Stop, that's enough, don't talk of it," said the girl… "But here I am home… Good-bye, thank you!..."
lines.intention: Touched a nerve; deflects and says goodbye

lines.text: "Surely ... surely you don't mean ... that we shall never see each other again?..."
"You see," said the girl, laughing, "at first you only wanted two words, and now...."
lines.intention: Amused by his greed for more

lines.text: "I shall come here to-morrow," I said. "Oh, forgive me, I am already making demands...."
"Yes, you are not very patient ... you are almost insisting."
"Listen, listen!" I interrupted her. "…I am a dreamer; I have so little real life…"
lines.intention: His defining speech: "I am a dreamer"

lines.text: "Very good," said the girl, "perhaps I will come here to-morrow, too, at ten o'clock…"
"A compact! Speak, tell me, tell me all beforehand; I agree to anything…"
"It's just because I do know you that I ask you to come to-morrow," said the girl, laughing…
lines.intention: Sets her one rule: don't fall in love

lines.text: "I swear," I cried, gripping her hand....
"Hush, don't swear, I know you are ready to flare up like gunpowder… I, too, have no one…"
"You will see ... the only thing is, I don't know how I am going to survive the next twenty-four hours."
"Sleep soundly. Good-night, and remember that I have trusted you already…"
"For God's sake do; but about what? What is it?"
"Wait till to-morrow. Meanwhile, let that be a secret…"
"Oh yes, I will tell you all about myself to-morrow! … It is as though a miracle had befallen me...."
"Very well, I consent; you shall begin...."
"Agreed."
"Good-bye till to-morrow!"
"Till to-morrow!"
And we parted. I walked about all night; I could not make up my mind to go home. I was so happy.... To-morrow!
lines.intention: Ends the night on pure happiness
